subject: S1 vessel geocoding: tie points on the sea surface
description: Owner decision 2026-10-20 (relayed by the marine-awareness session): S1 vessel detections sit 41-56 m toward the satellite because the GRD tie points are solved at ellipsoid height ~0 while the sea lies on the geoid (N ~37 m) and the GDAL TPS warp ignores Z. Fix in the one pipeline (fetch_s1_vessel_scenes): cache each tie point's incidence angle from the product annotation, move every tie point (N - z)/tan(inc) away from the satellite before every GCP consumer (radar window, window TIFF, sparse VRT, warp), EGM96 15' grid shipped as package data, half-pixel sample-centre correction as a separate flagged step, bump S1_VESSEL_CHAIN_VERSION, record the surface model in provenance. Tests: corrected tie points vs an independent range-Doppler solver, geocoding of frozen anchored-ship radar positions vs AIS hull centres (|median| <= 10 m), slow 06-28 end-to-end run skipped without a local cache. Intended files: imint/fetch.py, imint/geoid/ (grid + helper), pyproject.toml (package data), tests/test_s1_geocoding.py, tests/fixtures/s1_geocoding/, docs/marine/s1_vessels_reference.md. Stacked on agent/te/claude/s1-pass-choice (task 0111).
